mentions.name: Overtone
mentions.description: A web tool that visualizes the relationships documented in MusicBrainz, the large crowdsourced music database, using graphs. Any node can be right-clicked to expand into its subgraph. Planned next steps include creating playlists and listening to them without leaving the page.
mentions.source_excerpt: Still working on Overtone, a tool that allows one to visualize the relationships documented in MusicBrainz, probably the largest crowdsourced music DB in existence, using graphs. You can right-click anything to expand into its subgraph.

mentions.name: Overtone
mentions.description: This app is an interactive graph built from MusicBrainz data that maps musical artists, genres, albums, labels, instruments, and their relationships. It lets users explore musical neighborhoods and discover new artists by traversing the graph, and currently works well on desktop (beta).
mentions.source_excerpt: I’ve been exploring graph theory and built Overtone, an interactive graph that maps musical artists, genres, albums, labels, instruments, and their relationships using MusicBrainz data.
